speaker: (the carpenter)
text: Second rope. The long bay. Foot-men to the post. She is heavier than her sister.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: I have the foot. You have it with me.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: With you.

speaker: (the carpenter)
text: Heave.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: Legs.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have it.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: Stay with it.

speaker: (the carpenter)
text: She is going. Hold the foot till the brace takes her.

speaker: hamnet_sadler
text: Brace. She cannot come down again. Hold what you have.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: Hold her! Hold— Will, are you praying or lifting?

speaker: hamnet_sadler
text: Richard, do not let him sit. The bay is up. She is not coming down.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: I have her. Will. Stay on your feet. Do not sit, and do not be brave.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am on my feet. I did not fall.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: I see it now. Get a man under him who is not a ladder.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Thirty-one, and showing off to carpenters.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Anne.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: I have been at the edge since eight, with the jug. I saw the whole of it. You need not tell me which lift was the better one.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: Home. Between Sadler and me. He stays bent, and he stays moving.

speaker: hamnet_sadler
text: Take him. The ale can go to the men who want it. He does not. The cousin pays it.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: Go, Will. I'll come down when this peg is honest.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I can walk.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: You can walk between your brother and Sadler. That is the walk you have. Start it.

speaker: (the carpenter)
text: Leave the rope. You are in the way of the brace, and the brace is the work.

speaker: hamnet_sadler
text: Two bays are up. The other two can wait on men who can still bend. The frame is not coming down for one back.

speaker: richard_shakespeare
text: Start. I have the left side. Sadler has the right. You have the bent part, and you do not get to supervise it.
